Universal Patch Manager (UPM) is an Android manager for ReVanced, Morphe, and Reseam. It expands the patching workflow with third-party patch bundles, saved apps and patch profiles, batch and automatic repatching, flexible APK sources, advanced installers, and built-in APK tools.
